description:
At PicnicAI, we build intelligence to accelerate human health. We bring AI into the real-world complexity of care delivery and clinical research, where it gets decided whether patients get the care and treatments they need. We do this work in direct partnership with patients. PicnicAI powers two product lines: PicnicResearch for sponsors and research organizations, and PicnicHealth for patients and their caregivers.

PicnicResearch makes clinical research faster, more cost-effective, and more reliable to unlock an abundance of new treatments for patients. Patients enroll remotely, and we retrieve complete medical records across all treating providers, with no site network required. By combining scientific expertise, patient-connected study design, and AI-enhanced infrastructure, we help sponsors answer their research questions and stay connected with patients over time.

15 of the top 20 biopharma companies rely on PicnicResearch to generate clinical evidence. Our work spans 40+ diseases in 10+ therapeutic areas and has produced 75+ publications. Founded in 2014, we’ve raised more than $100M from investors including Amplify Partners, Felicis Ventures, B Capital Group, and Y Combinator. We’re a team of doctors, patients, data specialists, engineers, and builders working to change how clinical research gets done.

The Opportunity

As a Senior / Principal Epidemiologist, you’ll help shape how PicnicResearch works in practice. You’ll lead the science on complex real-world and observational studies for pharma and biotech partners: natural history studies, registries, safety and effectiveness studies, and studies that support regulatory submissions. You’ll also help advance how those studies get done. You’ll use AI in your daily work, test new approaches, and help convert the most effective ones into standard practices across the team.

This role reports to the Head of Scientific Delivery. We’ll set the level (Senior or Principal) based on experience and fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as the primary scientific point of contact for sponsors, giving expert guidance and recommendations that help them meet their research goals.
  • Lead the design, execution, and interpretation of observational research studies using primary data (PROs, ClinROs, wearables) and secondary data (medical records/EHR, claims).
  • Use AI across your study work, from drafting and review to analysis and QC, and pilot new methods, workflows, and tools, helping put what works into practice across our studies.
  • Ensure scientific rigor from protocol to publication: write the core study documents, translate sponsor needs into clear requirements, and partner with your Study Project Manager and specialist teams (biostatistics, data management, recruitment, patient engagement, compliance and product) to deliver on our commitments.
  • Drive thought leadership through publications and presentations with internal teams and sponsors, advancing PicnicResearch’s scientific credibility.
  • Provide scientific mentorship and guidance to other team members, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

What we’re looking for:

  • PhD in epidemiology, public health, outcomes research or a related field (a strong MPH/MS with equivalent experience will also be considered).
  • 6+ years designing and leading observational or real-world data studies in pharma, biotech, a CRO or a similar setting, including managing multiple concurrent studies.
  • Deep knowledge of epidemiological methods and the judgment to apply them across study types and indications.
  • Experience with a range of real-world data sources, such as EHR/medical records, patient-reported outcomes, wearables, and claims.
  • A strong track record of authoring study documents, including protocols, ICFs, study reports and scientific publications.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in your scientific work, and proven ability to adapt quickly to new technology and workflows.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to build trust with senior sponsor stakeholders and drive alignment on complex scientific questions.
  • Comfort working across functions, including non-scientific teams such as operations, product and engineering.
  • Proficiency in statistical software (R preferred).

How you work:

  • You’re excited to use AI to accelerate clinical research. You want to work somewhere that expects it, and you’re always looking for the next way it can make studies better.
  • You experiment. You try new methods and tools, measure what works, and act on it.
  • You adapt. Our processes evolve as we find better ways to work, and you help lead that.
  • You work independently. You make sound decisions in ambiguous situations, take ownership of your work, and know when to bring others in.
  • You’re practical. You keep a high scientific bar and know how to make it work operationally.

We expect all team members to be amazing in their roles and, ultimately, to move the PicnicResearch mission forward.

The other perks & benefits you get when you work at PicnicAI

We pay competitive salaries. Everyone on the team is an owner: all full time employees get competitive equity.

Target Base Salary Range: $150K - 200K

The base salary PicnicAI offers may vary depending upon the scope, complexity, and autonomy of the position and on the candidate’s job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

We’re a remote first company, with teammates spread across the US. We support in-person gatherings, including co-working spaces and multi-day onsites, to build connections and move forward strategic initiatives. Travel varies by role.

You also get:

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • Family friendly environment
  • Flexible time off
  • Picnic Friday holidays: extended long weekends on select Fridays throughout the year
  • 401k plan
  • Free PicnicHealth account
  • Equipment and internet funds for home office set up
  • Quarterly wellness stipend

PicnicAI is committed to promoting an inclusive work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We value a diverse and balanced team where everyone can belong.
